description: MAPA 06/2024. Achat de divers matériels de télécommunication en 5 lots sur 2 ans. Relance du lot n°4 déclaré sans suite is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Commune de Brignoles. This contract concerns the relaunch of Lot 4: Cabling of the previous contract for the purchase of various telecommunications equipment in 5 lots over 2 years. Its object is the purchase of telecommunications equipment with installation and printing services. Coverage: Commune de Brignoles. The portal shows the English title as "MAPA 06/2024. Purchase of various telecommunications equipment in 5 lots over 2 years. Relaunch of lot 4 declared withou" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Commune de Brignoles. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2024-06-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
